name: MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI
readme:
# MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI

Deploy → **Connect → MOSS ComfyUI** → choose a workflow → enter a prompt → Run.

Runpod supplies the connection token. No separate password, Hugging Face token, terminal command or storage edit is required for first use. The connection page shows preparation progress while six public model files (23.51 GB) download and verify. Two tested cold launches took about 7 min 33 s and no more than 18 min 55 s; timing depends on the host and network.

## Included workflows

- SFT Photography — BF16, 1216×1664, 25 steps, CFG 2.5.
- SFT Fast — INT8 with two compatible LoRA slots, 1024×1024.
- Image variation — experimental latent repainting.
- Official SFT — browser prompt enhancement.

Use one supported NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM. Compatible CUDA 13.0 and 13.2 hosts are enabled. The template requests a 60 GB container disk. For retained models, edited workflows and images, select persistent storage mounted at `/workspace` in Runpod Storage; the launch screen selects that separately.

## Startup script

The image includes `/opt/moss/scripts/entrypoint.sh`, explicitly selected as the Container start command. It initializes Runpod SSH, starts the protected progress page, prepares models and supervises ComfyUI through the image's `tini` entry point. No external startup-script download is needed.

The exact 0.1.1 image passed fresh browser generation, all four workflow imports, GPU presets, compatible LoRA inference, prompt enhancement, API and restart-preservation checks. Execution tests do not guarantee a particular aesthetic result.

Documentation, API examples, licenses and validation: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/moss-runpod
